text:
alex: Quick heads-up — branch freeze tomorrow 10:00 PST. Two asks: confirm version bump strategy and a docs dry-run. Anyone owning changelog + doc sign-off?

maria: I can own the changelog. Which semver are we doing — patch or minor?

devon: Minor. Feature flags landed in the last sprint so bumping to 0.27.x makes sense. @maria I’ll prep the changelog PRs and tag you.

sarah: Docs dry-run — I can run through the new flags, CLI examples, and reference pages this afternoon. Which branch should I test the build against?

alex: Use release/v0.27.x. Also plan to bump package.json to 0.27.0-rc.1 before the freeze. Example command to update locally:

```bash
sed -i 's/"version": ".*"/"version": "0.27.0-rc.1"/' package.json
git add package.json && git commit -m "chore: bump version to 0.27.0-rc.1"
```

qa_lead: QA plan: will kick off smoke on staging tonight. Any DB migrations or long-running tasks we should schedule a window for?

devon: No DB migrations for this release — only a config toggle and a few model mapping changes. Smoke plan: run e2e --smoke, quick latency sweep on core endpoints, and a token-cost sanity check. I’ll paste the checklist shortly.

ops-bot: Reminder: branch-freeze scheduled at 2087730721 (tomorrow 10:00 PST). Auto-merge disabled on release/v0.27.x.

security-bot: Security scan queued. @alex please ensure any third-party dependency updates are listed in the CHANGELOG under a 'security' subsection. If the scan finds high issues we’ll block the freeze.

maria: Changelog PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/412 — includes feature highlights, migration notes, and a security note placeholder. Need docs link before I merge.

sarah: Docs PR ready for dry-run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/99 — I’ll do a walkthrough at 3:00 PM PT and demo the CLI examples. @qa_lead can you join for the smoke verification?

alex: :thumbsup: Plan sounds good. Quick checklist to be green before freeze: (1) version bumped to 0.27.0-rc.1, (2) changelog PR merged, (3) docs dry-run completed, (4) QA smoke green, (5) security scan clear. Reply here when each item is done so we have an audit trail.

qa_lead: On it — I’ll post results here after the smoke runs. :eyes:
